chunks: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.

key_terms.يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ: to thank people for the good they do

ai.seo_question: Why does Islam link thanking people with thanking Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that gratitude to people for their kindness is inseparable from gratitude to Allah. One who fails to acknowledge the good done by others shows a deficiency in thankfulness itself. It is a concise Prophetic teaching on adab, social conduct, and moral character.
